description: A chess set box sits on the tabletop, and a yellow-and-black tape measure is used in front of it. The right hand picks up the tape measure, pulls the metal tape out and stretches it diagonally across the chess box while the left hand steadies the box edge, then the right hand retracts the tape, repositions it upright briefly to check another dimension, and finally extends it horizontally across the top of the box before pulling it back in again.
